# QHEForgeEigenstate

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnDisk` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnDisk/QHEForgeEigenstate`

```text
QHEForgeEigenstate, version 0.01

Usage: QHEForgeEigenstate [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (overriding the one found in the vector file name if greater than 0) (default value = 0)
    -l, --momentum : single particle momentum (overriding the one found in the vector file name if greater than 0) (value must be greater than 0, default value = 0)
    --bosons : use boson statistics
    --fermions : use fermion statistics
    -o, --output : name of the vector output file
    -i, --input : name of the file that contains the eigenstate description
    --additional-state : name of the file that contains an optional state that will be added to the one describde by the input file
    --additional-coefficient : multiplicative coefficient that will be used on the additional state (default value = 0)

misc options:
```
